# NumberBoxSpinButtonPlacementMode

[C# API](../index.md) / [Fluence.Wpf](index.md)

- **Assembly:** `Fluence.Wpf`
- **Namespace:** `Fluence.Wpf`

```csharp
public enum NumberBoxSpinButtonPlacementMode
```

Placement of the [NumberBox](../Fluence.Wpf.Controls/NumberBox.md) spin buttons. Matches WinUI's `NumberBoxSpinButtonPlacementMode`.

[C# source](https://github.com/sintaxasn/Fluence.Wpf/blob/main/Fluence.Wpf/NumberBoxSpinButtonPlacementMode.cs)

## Values

<a id="api-f2a9fe297cd1"></a>

### Compact

```csharp
Compact = 1
```

Spin buttons appear when the control is hovered or keyboard-focused.

<a id="api-140c530cfa21"></a>

### Hidden

```csharp
Hidden = 0
```

<a id="api-02e3dc0ca337"></a>

### Inline

```csharp
Inline = 2
```
